apps.subtitle: Experimental Home player and Timbre EQ widgets
apps.localizedDescription: Side-by-side experimental Amazon Timbre Lab. Preserves the original working app and its data; retains Timbre 19 DSP code with an additive playback metadata bridge and player/EQ widgets. Restores Amazon's native login/deep-link URL schemes in the Lab build. Both installed apps now claim Amazon callback schemes, so iOS may direct those links to either app. Separate sign-in may still be required or rejected. Native Lock Screen media-card launch remains unverified. Unsigned IPA: sign the parent app, widget extension, and both embedded dylibs before installation.
